newsitem.title: UK: Bank of Scotland up on newspaper report.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Scotland up on newspaper report.

text.p: Shares in Bank of Scotland were boosted in early trading on Thursday by a positive newspaper reception to annual results, dealers said.
Bank of Scotland shares were up 7.5 pence, or 2.22 percent, to 346p by 0730 GMT, while the FTSE-100 index was 0.16 percent lower at 4,380.6.

The Financial Times newspaper's influential Lex Column said the market should re-examine its prejudice towards a stock which has been trading at a 20 percent price/earnings discount to similar stocks despite making a return on equity of around 35 percent for the past three years.
